summary: Elder brother of John's ancestor Leopoldo Ferlaino, born at San Mango d'Aquino in 1870 and dead within months.
bio: Leopoldo Ferlaino was born at San Mango d'Aquino about 4 February 1870 and died there on 12 July 1870, about five months old. His name was given to the next son of the family, born in 1871, who became John's ancestor.
